{"command": "python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
h,w=a.shape
out=np.zeros_like(a)
# tiled local contrast normalization
tile=256; step=128
acc=np.zeros_like(a); cnt=np.zeros_like(a)
for y in range(0,h-tile+1,step):
    for x in range(0,w-tile+1,step):
        t=a[y:y+tile,x:x+tile]
        lo,hi=np.percentile(t,5),np.percentile(t,95)
        if hi-lo<1: hi=lo+1
        n=np.clip((t-lo)/(hi-lo)*255,0,255)
        acc[y:y+tile,x:x+tile]+=n; cnt[y:y+tile,x:x+tile]+=1
cnt[cnt==0]=1
out=(acc/cnt).astype(np.uint8)
Image.fromarray(out).save('loc.png')
print('ok')
"", "description": "Tiled local contrast normalization"}
